messages:
Lina Kwong: hey team - quick one. I used the corp card at SFO (small airport kiosk) to buy conference keychains + sticker packs for our booth on 2026-06-12. Statement shows merchant as 'A1RMALL' and the receipt we got has only a total (no itemization or VAT). Charge: $58.23. Can I submit this?
Marta (Finance): thanks for checking, Lina. We can cover promotional items under MKT-SWAG but we need either an itemized receipt or a missing-receipt attestation + manager approval. Please upload the photo of the slip and a screenshot of the card transaction to the expense.
Lina Kwong: uploaded receipt_photo.jpg and stmt_screenshot.png to the thread. The physical slip literally just says "A1RMALL" and a 4-digit terminal id. No tax line. These were handed out at our booth (not individual client gifts).
Marta (Finance): ok good detail. Steps to close this out: 1) create an expense in Expensify (or our expenses UI) for $58.23; 2) attach the card statement screenshot + receipt photo; 3) complete the "missing small receipt" form on the intranet (https://intranet.redwood/finance/missing-receipt) and select "merchant printed short slip" as the reason; 4) set category = MKT-SWAG and project = CONF-SFQ24; 5) add a note that the items were distributed at the booth.
Lina Kwong: @Kevin L can you give a quick approval note?
Kevin L (Manager): approved. Confirmed these are booth promotional items and under $100. Approving reimbursement. :white_check_mark:
finance-bot: Expense created: EXP-4821. Please ensure all attachments are on the ticket. Reimbursement will be processed in the next payroll cycle after coding.
Marta (Finance): one more thing - if Expensify flags merchant-name mismatch, add a short comment: "merchant prints as A1RMALL; purchase was airport retail at SFO for conference swag." Once you mark as manager-approved and attach the missing-receipt form we're good to go.
